page.layout: One printed page, cover sheet from the digitiser: e-rara logo at top right; title block centred in the upper half; a horizontal rule; four short paragraphs of disclaimer text in the lower half; a second rule; terms of use paragraphs in four languages; Visual Library logo at bottom right. No margin text.
page.notes: The digitiser's cover sheet (e-rara and Visual Library logos, the rules, and the multilingual terms-of-use and access notices) is not printed book text and is left out of the transcription. The title block is reproduced as a title page, with the digitiser's web address and persistent link included only as shown on the scan.
